use_cases: Displaying eye-catching animated hero text on landing pages to capture visitor attention
Creating visual transitions between text messages in marketing campaigns
Adding dynamic typography effects to SaaS product presentations
Enhancing visual appeal of call-to-action sections with particle animations
Providing immersive text reveal animations for creative portfolios
ai_summary: A canvas-based particle text animation component that renders text as colorful particles and vaporizes them with physics-based effects. Features include rotation, scaling, glow effects, color shifting, and smooth transitions between text states. Ideal for hero sections and attention-grabbing displays on landing pages and marketing sites.
